faq_h2: Palacio Del Mar Homes: Common Questions

faq.q: How much do homes in Palacio Del Mar cost?
faq.a: In the last 12 months, 9 single-family homes in Palacio Del Mar sold between $1.98M and $2.34M, at a median of $2.18M. See the price-by-size cards and recent sales on this page for what each kind of home sold for.

faq.q: How many homes are in Palacio Del Mar?
faq.a: Palacio Del Mar has about 422 homes, built 1989 to 2020.

faq.q: What school area is Palacio Del Mar in?
faq.a: Palacio Del Mar is in the Sage Canyon Elementary attendance area (Del Mar Union School District). High school is Torrey Pines High (San Dieguito Union HSD), with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy available by lottery. School boundaries change, so confirm any address with the district before you buy.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell in Palacio Del Mar?
faq.a: Over the last 12 months, the median Palacio Del Mar home sold in 11 days on market. Well-priced homes often go under contract in the first week.
